answer: One kiln per applicant stops fake identities. A forester assigns a numbered kiln, and each operator burns 40 kilos of coppiced oak over 72 hours, then weighs the sacks. A yarrow stalk at the vent bends in the heat, and the ripple above the mouth shows the burn has finished. White smoke signals the load is ready, a neighbor signs the tally, and a ranger checks the ash twice. A forged tally forfeits a 150 token deposit and bars the keeper 180 days. Faking 10,000 kilns freezes 1,500,000 tokens and costs 900,000 dollars, like 10,000 campfires in one wood. The smoke gives every fake away.
